name: aurora kinase A
pathways: regulation of signal transduction by p53 class mediator

function.text: AURKA encodes aurora kinase A. Annotated molecular activities include protein kinase activity and protein serine kinase activity. It participates in regulation of signal transduction by p53 class mediator and cilium disassembly.
